open_questions.question: Does every invertible M outside K{I,X,Z,XZ} have excess 2 at odd widths f>=3 and all four characters at even widths f>=4?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A positive answer extends the q-call count of PR #5482 to all invertible nonordinary tensor powers.
open_questions.first_step: Write r M^tensor f in R as a linear relation among the eight tensor powers of sigma M and sigma, and treat widths 3 to 6 separately.
open_questions.blocked_by: The tensor-power independence lemma needs f>=7 for eight vectors; the tested invertible cases are finite observations only.

open_questions.question: Can two paid calls, each a fixed linear operator applied to one current field, deliver the three width-two X/Y/Z-type targets?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It decides whether history sharing is realizable as a program or whether operator calls obey a stronger floor.
open_questions.first_step: Write the returns in the Bell basis and solve the bilinear system for two operators and two ordinary fields.
